derivation.behavior: Canonical network intent supports GET/POST, headers, body refs, mirrors, validators and expected hashes.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go request is a strict superset of donor transport semantics with safe persisted form and runtime secret resolution.

invariants: Transport URL and logical resource identity remain distinct.
Safe serialization contains body/credential references but never resolved secret bytes.
GET/POST, mirrors, validators, expected length, checksum, source metadata, backend preference and approval references survive canonicalization.
Unsupported method/body combinations fail with typed reasons.
